content.markdown: John Stone, OSA was an English Augustinian friar who was executed, probably in December 1539; he was canonized in 1970 by Pope Paul VI, and is one of the Forty Martyrs of England and Wales. He was a doctor of theology from Canterbury.

descriptions.en: (d. 1539) English Augustinian, Catholic saint and martyr
